messages.onb_p1_msg:
Hariku V2 is a completely rebuilt version of the original Hariku V1 calendar.

It brings a revolutionary new Extension Architecture, allowing the community to build, share, and install new features seamlessly from the Cloud Store without bloating the main application.

We hope you love the radical changes and the blazingly fast performance!

Click Next to continue your setup.
messages.onb_p2_msg:
DATA PRIVACY:
Your schedule is yours. All your calendar events, reminders, and data are encrypted and stored locally on your device. Nothing is sent to the cloud unless you explicitly use a Cloud Extension.

GLOBAL HOTKEY:
Hariku runs quietly in the background. No matter what app you are currently using, you can instantly summon Hariku by pressing Ctrl + Alt + H on your keyboard.

Click Next to proceed.
